answer: One defense is a refundable copper stake anchored to a verifiable work history: to join the market, each agent locks a small deposit and links its identity to a public record of past completed tasks. A new identity starts with no history, so a whisper of doubt follows every unsigned claim until the agent proves itself. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs thousands of deposits and months of fabricated history, while honest agents earn their stake back with interest, making sybil attacks expensive and slow but honest participation cheap.
